title: Extraction Method F
author: Faezah Mohd Salleh
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.infcdbn
materials: Discard supernatant without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Prepare tissue lysate
steps.instruction: Cut 25–50 mg tissue into small pieces, add 500 µL Lyse 1, add 50 µL Lyse 2, add 10 µL Proteinase K, then incubate in a thermomixer at 65 °C for 12 hours.

substeps.instruction: Cut tissue (25–50 mg) into small pieces.
Incubate at 65 °C for 12 h in a thermomixer.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube for 10 minutes at 13,000 rpm.

steps.title: Add Lyse 3 and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 375 µL Lyse 3, vortex for 20 seconds, then place the tube in a –20 °C freezer for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add 640 µL isopropanol, then centrifuge for 15 minutes at 13,000 rpm.

steps.title: Discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant without touching the pellet.

steps.title: Wash pellet with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL ethanol, centrifuge for 5 minutes at 13,000 rpm, then remove the ethanol without touching the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Remove ethanol without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Dry DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet at 37 °C with the lid open for up to 5 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA in Buffer AE
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 100 µL Buffer AE.

steps.title: Measure DNA concentration
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Darmstadt, DE).

steps.title: Mix sample by inversion
steps.instruction: Mix the resuspended DNA by inversion.
